info.title: Switch Frame Tap
info.author: TomasUribe
info.description: Stream gameplay and audio to a PC without a capture card.
info.details:
Switch Frame Tap is a sysmodule for streaming gameplay and audio to a PC over USB or the network. It uses the H.264 encoder and supports up to 1080p60fps where available.

It supports native-resolution screenshots, recording through the PC viewer, network streaming, and USB webcam mode.

A reboot is required after installation or updating so the sysmodule can restart.

changelog:
v0.7.14

**v0.7.14: the HOME menu and the console's overlays in the stream, a new Switch app, and updates from the apps**

![The quick settings and Ultrahand streamed to the PC](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TomasUribe/switch-frame-tap/master/docs/showcase-0.7.14-overlays.jpg)

- **Stream the console's overlays (opt-in).** On the Beta page of the Switch Frame Tap app (or in its overlay), turn on **Stream the overlays** and restart. The volume bar, the quick settings (hold HOME), the power menu (hold POWER) and Tesla / Ultrahand menus then show on top of the game, in the viewer and in recordings. They are copied 10-20 times a second, so they move a little less smoothly than the game, and the power menu and 1080p look a bit soft.
- **Stream the HOME menu (opt-in).** **Stream the HOME menu** shows the HOME menu from boot, System Settings, the user picker, Controllers, My Page, the Album (hold R while opening it) and the Homebrew Menu, and going from a game to the HOME menu and back keeps streaming. No sound outside games yet.
- **A new look for the Switch app:** pages on the left (Home, Stream, Picture, Screenshots, Beta, Extras, Setup, Updates, About), the stream's state at a glance, switches for on/off settings. L and R change pages.
- **Updates from the apps.** The Switch app's new **Updates** page checks GitHub and installs a new version for you (sysmodule, overlay and app - restart the console after). The PC viewers (Windows, Linux, macOS) and the Android app look for a new version when they open and update themselves with one click. **Include betas** offers test versions too. From now on, no more zips by hand.
- **The Android / Android TV app** (by didix16) is part of the release: `switch-frame-tap-0.7.14-android.apk`, for Android TV, Google TV, phones and tablets (Android 6+), over the network or USB. Install it with a file manager that can install apps.
- **Fixes:** opening the eShop from the HOME menu while streaming works again (firmware 22 and later). A failed engine setup no longer needs a reboot. Shorter gaps going from the HOME menu into a game. Should fix the stream not coming back in Pokémon Violet after a drop (#20). The Android app replaces a decoder that drops most frames (should fix 1 fps on Chromecast 4K, #27).
- **Viewers:** a new borderless Windows viewer window with responsive settings, and network streams that show a picture right away when the viewer joins mid-game (both by bshurikan). The viewers explain USB-C to USB-C cable trouble. A PC without a working GPU driver gets a picture (drawn in software) instead of an error.

Both betas are **off by default**. With them off it streams like v0.7.13.2 (same frame rate and timings side by side); the sysmodule needs about 0.1 MB more system memory.

**Installing:** unzip `switch-frame-tap-0.7.14-switch.zip` over the SD card root and reboot (settings are kept), and install the new viewer. Next time, the apps can do it for you.

---
<sub>Switch Frame Tap is free and open source. If you would like to support it: [buymeacoffee.com/papux200](https://buymeacoffee.com/papux200)</sub>
